name: Submit Passkey MFA Proof
summary: Completes a user-verified Passkey assertion for the durable identity bound to a password-issued MFA challenge and establishes an authenticated session only after both the WebAuthn proof and MFA challenge are satisfied.

requiredInputs.description: Short-lived password-issued MFA challenge that identifies the durable user and allows provider passkey.
Single-use user-bound WebAuthn assertion challenge issued after validating the MFA challenge.
User-verified WebAuthn assertion returned by the platform authenticator.

guards.expression: the password-issued MFA challenge is valid, allows passkey, and identifies the same durable user as the WebAuthn challenge and stored credential

sourceReferences.note: Challenge-bound MFA orchestration validates provider and UserId, invokes real Passkey proof, then consumes the password-issued MFA challenge.
User-bound Passkey completion consumes the WebAuthn challenge, validates credential ownership and assertion proof, advances the counter, and records MFA freshness.
